sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A baobab endemic to northern Madagascar. A specimen record from the Muséum national d’Histoire naturelle describes a tree about 30 m tall, with pale-yellow petals and leaves with five to six leaflets on the collected material. A species-level crown width was not verified.

sections.title: Conservation and comparison
sections.text: Kew reports the IUCN status as Critically Endangered. Unlike the widespread African A. digitata, this baobab is restricted to northern Madagascar; it also differs from A. suarezensis in its species-level morphology and conservation assessment. Food use, toxicity and specific human uses were not verified in the sources consulted.
